## Symptom

`tests/unit/test_pinned_ticket_view.py::test_tree_listed_ticket_blob_missing_from_object_database_fails_closed[packed-_drop_packed]`
failed the GATING cell (`pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)`, `not integration and not external`) of
GitHub Actions run 33989904007, casting a spurious `Verified -1` on Gerrit change 2682
(ticket d645-8f51-0ff9-4070), whose diff touches only workflow YAML, a parity script and
unrelated test modules — nothing on this test's path.

```
tests/unit/test_pinned_ticket_view.py:657: in _drop_loose
    assert loose.is_file(), f"expected {blob_oid} to be loose; got {loose}"
E   AssertionError: expected 78f74eda8e30b413767ae9771c467593a28ca9c8 to be loose
1 failed, 19942 passed, 82 skipped
```

The test failed on its own scaffolding, before exercising `PinnedTicketView` at all. The
`loose` sibling parametrization passed in the same run, so the storage shape was decided
nondeterministically, not systematically.

## Root cause

`_mount_or_create_branch()` in `src/rebar/_commands/init.py` creates the tracker worktree and
makes the store's first commits, and `_commit_precommit()` makes another — all BEFORE
`_run_ensures_logged()` runs `_gc_config_unit`, the ensure that pins
`gc.autoDetach=false` / `maintenance.autoDetach=false` (ADR 0051, bug 88eb).

Inside that window git is at its DEFAULTS, so each `git commit` spawns
`git maintenance run --auto --quiet --detach` — a background child that OUTLIVES the command
that spawned it and mutates the SHARED object database of the host repo the tracker worktree
is linked into. Measured with `GIT_TRACE2_EVENT` replaying this test's own fixture sequence
(git 2.55): 7 maintenance children, of which **2 are `--detach`**, both attributed by trace2
`cmd_name` to `commit` inside `rebar init`; every later child (post-ensure) is `--no-detach`.

The test's `_freeze_gc()` sets `gc.auto=0` to make the blob's storage shape constructible, but
a detached child that started BEFORE the freeze already read git's default config and cannot
be called back. When it repacks, `git prune-packed` removes the loose copies — including the
freshly written `*-CREATE.json` blob the test then asserts is loose. `git rev-parse` still
resolved the oid in CI, which is only possible if the object had moved into a pack.

This is the SAME mechanism the store already root-caused for fixture bare remotes and
documented in `tests/_git_upkeep.py`: `subprocess.run()` returning is not a happens-before
edge for that repository's object database. Bugs 88eb-2beb-65f5-4bc0, dca1-f641-caeb-4df4,
b394-6198-6010-42f7, 5b74-5d8f-a6b4-4674 and 57d2-e356-7eb4-4bf5 all closed instances of it;
none covered rebar's own init window, which is the remaining gap. It is also a real
ADR-0051 invariant hole in the product, not only a test problem: a detached repack of the
shared object DB runs OUTSIDE rebar's write lock, which is precisely the store-corruption
hazard ADR 0051 exists to prevent.

## Fix

Pin the posture BEFORE the store's first commit rather than after it: invoke the existing,
idempotent `_gc_config_unit` at the top of `_mount_or_create_branch`, against the host repo
whose `.git/config` the tracker worktree shares. No new mechanism and no new config keys —
the same unit already writes the same three settings to the same file, just too late. The
post-bootstrap `_run_ensures_logged()` sweep is unchanged and now converges as a no-op.

## Acceptance criteria

- AC1: `rebar init` on a fresh repository leaves ZERO `--detach` maintenance children, proven
  by a `GIT_TRACE2_EVENT` assertion over `_git_upkeep.maintenance_children()`.
- AC2: The `gc.autoDetach` / `maintenance.autoDetach` / `gc.auto` settings written are
  unchanged in value and location; `_gc_config_unit` remains their single definition.
- DONE AC3: `make verify` is green. Evidence: local run in `/Users/joeoakhart/gaps-close-tickets` at HEAD `53d18aad2ab9c526ff3729ceefeaa68c45014551`, with injected `GIT_CONFIG_*` unset after the known host-artifact solo check; `19932 passed, 80 skipped, 14 warnings in 2244.78s (0:37:24)`, `RC=0`, ended 2026-09-07T02:04:54Z.

## Definition of done

- A regression test that fails before the fix and passes after it.
- `make verify` green; change lands through Gerrit with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`.
